description:
List of all templates

TIP: Lists the templates Endpoint security policies are created from. Each has id (templateId), baseId, version, displayName, description, displayVersion, lifecycleState (active, superseded, deprecated, retired), platforms, technologies and templateFamily. Use it to find the templateReference.templateId to pass to create-configuration-policy, and to spot policies built on a superseded template. Filter with $filter=templateFamily eq 'endpointSecurityDiskEncryption' and lifecycleState eq 'active'. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $expand, $count.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-configuration-policy-templates
